Jeff Strasser’s men have now failed to score in 10 of their last 15 outings, and their H2H record against the Bulgarians remains ominous despite their recent victory.

Four players are confirmed missing for Luxembourg: Leandro Barreiro, Enes Mahmutovic, Daniel Sinani and Laurent Jans.

As for Bulgaria, they are also dealing with two new suspensions; Lukas Petkov and Dimitar Velkovski are banned for yellow card accumulation. [...] Luxembourg have won one and lost two of their three UNL fixtures.
 The Red Lions beat Bulgaria 2-1 in their previous H2H in September.
 Bulgaria have lost two and drawn one of their three UNL games.
 The Tricolours have seen over 2.5 total goals in nine of their last 11 competitive games.
